title: nf-core/oncoseq pipeline parameters
description: Oncology analysis pipeline for WGS data.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row. See [usage docs](https://nf-co.re/oncoseq/usage#samplesheet-input).

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

report_review.description: Generate an additional offline leukemia review report.

publish_ubam.description: Publish one consolidated unaligned BAM containing quality-passing and quality-failing reads.

publish_intermediate_bams.description: Publish diagnostic intermediate BAMs; shard BAMs remain unpublished.

review_references.description: Optional JSON annotation resource mapping; clinical defaults use bundled unpinned development paths. Checksummed manifests remain supported.

review_fusion_distance.description: Maximum distance in bases at each breakpoint for conservative caller consensus.

qc_extended.description: Add cellular DNA QC to metrics and reports; requires explicit exact targets.

qc_targets_bed.description: Explicit exact-target BED for additive QC, independent of enrichment padding.

qc_sample_manifest.description: TSV of sample and targets_bed overrides.

qc_cpg_panels.description: Optional versioned classifier CpG panel manifest.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

pipeline_doi.description: DOI for the pipeline, used in the help message.

before_text.description: Text to display before the help message.

after_text.description: Text to display after the help message.

pipeline_version.description: Version of the pipeline, used in the help message.

show_hidden.description: Show hidden parameters in the help message.

hook_url.description: Incoming hook URL for messaging service
hook_url.help_text: Incoming hook URL for messaging service. Currently, MS Teams and Slack are supported.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

qdnaseq_binsize.description: Bin size to use for CNV calling with QDNAseq (Kbp)

bed.description: Bed file used for adaptive mode (default is latest CRA-CHUSJ panel)

igenomes_base.description: Base path for illumina genomes to pull from AWS, typically not changed

mapping_small.description: Option for finetuning time ressources allocation for minimap2. Set to false if a big genome is to be aligned (human whole genome 30X)

wgs.description: When used in non adaptive WGS mode predicted to be ~30X, use --wgs to increase resources allocation for basecalling.

huge.description: Scale resource allocations for very large datasets.

clairsto_indel_min_af.description: Minimum indel allele fraction for ClairS-TO candidate generation.

deepsomatic_indel_min_af.description: Minimum indel allele fraction for DeepSomatic candidate generation.

clairsto_model.description: ClairS_TO model to use for SNP calling

low_fidelity.description: Path to text file containing list of genes of low fidelity for adaptive sampling (default is empty list)

padding.description: Padding around region of interest for adaptive sampling

skip_basecalling.description: Option to skip basecalling and start with fastq files in the samplesheet input column

max_memory.description: Maximum memory any process can consume

max_cpus.description: Maximum cpus any process can use

max_time.description: Maximum amount of time any process can take

realtime.description: Use number of sequencing hour to activate real time mode

sv_targets.description: List of genes to visualize with Figeno (columns GENE and pos)

fusion_targets.description: List of important fusions to verify with stellerator

sv_exclude.description: List of genes to exclude from SV analysis (possible artefacts)

snp_exclude.description: List of genes to exclude from snp analysis

pharmcat_genes.description: List of pharmacogenes to include in PharmCAT analysis (text file, one gene per line)

classy_container.description: Specify a different container for Classy module (default: same as pipeline container)

max_length.description: Maximum length (in bases) of reads to include in cfdna analysis (if filter true in samplesheet)

min_mapq_ichor.description: Minimum MAPQ of reads to include in ichorCNA analysis

ichor_bin_size.description: Bin size to use for IchorCNA (in bases)

chr_wig.description: Comma-separated chromosome list used by readCounter to build the wig file

custom_ploidy.description: Candidate tumour ploidy values passed to run IchorCNA.R (R vector syntax)

genome_style.description: Chromosome naming style ichorCNA should use internally (UCSC or Ensembl)

estimate_sc_prevalence.description: Estimate subclonal prevalence within IchorCNA (default is false, which is faster)

ubam.description: Placeholder for incomplete ubam, to use basecalling resume, specify path to incomplete ubam in samplesheet

delly_bin_size.description: Bin size to use with Delly CNV calling

vep_cache.description: Optional root directory for Ensembl VEP caches. The selected version and genome assembly are downloaded automatically on the Nextflow launch host when absent; that host must have internet access.

filtervep_expression.default: IMPACT != LOW and IMPACT != MODIFIER and (gnomADe_AF <= 0.01 or not gnomADe_AF) and not CLIN_SIG matches benign and MANE
filtervep_expression.description: Expression accepted by filtervep for filtering snp

basecall_shards.description: Maximum deterministic POD5 file groups per sample/project. Uses at most one shard per input file.

dorado_model_cache.description: Optional separate directory of complete versioned Dorado models, including an existing S3 model prefix.

reference_aux_cache.description: Optional separate cache for auxiliary reference files under their source basenames.

ref_cache.description: Path to directory containing reference genome

clinical.description: Use the frozen clinical candidate configuration.

aws_region.description: AWS region from the Terraform outputs.

aws_gpu_queue.description: General-purpose NVIDIA GPU AWS Batch queue.

aws_bam_high_vcpus.description: CPU reservation on the BAM high queue.

aws_bam_low_vcpus.description: CPU reservation on the BAM low queue.

aws_job_role.description: IAM role ARN assumed by Batch tasks.

aws_logs_group.description: CloudWatch group for Batch task logs.

aws_cli_path.description: Self-contained AWS CLI executable on Batch workers.

run_id.description: Run identifier appended to Terraform work and result prefixes.

aws_basecall_queue.description: Dedicated NVIDIA GPU AWS Batch queue for Dorado basecalling.

input_ubam.description: Start from one sample-separated unaligned BAM per samplesheet row. Validate the first 1000 reads and stream into alignment, preserving methylation tags.

ubam_min_qscore.description: Minimum qs tag score for streamed uBAM read filtering. Zero disables this filter and the qs tag requirement.

classy_blood.description: Run the new blood Classy step and use its results in reports; preserve the legacy execution.

classy_blood_enable_alma3.description: Enable ALMA3.1 native approximation in the blood classifier; numerical parity is not established.

classy_blood_alma3_modification_mode.description: ALMA3 modification mode, independent of the basecalling model specification.
